questions.stem_md: $ABC$ uchburchakda $AB=9$ sm, $AC=15$ sm, uchburchakning yuzi $48$ sm². $AD$ kesma $\angle A$ ning bissektrisasi ($D$ nuqta $BC$ tomonda yotadi). $ABD$ uchburchakning yuzini (sm² da) toping.

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polygon points="138.2,32 72.6,125.6 247.4,188" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="138.2" y1="32" x2="138.2" y2="149" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><path d="M 125.5 50 A 22 22 0 0 0 138.2 54" fill="none" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="1.6"/><path d="M 138.2 54 A 22 22 0 0 0 150.8 50" fill="none" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="1.6"/><text x="138.2" y="17" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="57.7" y="127.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="259.3" y="197.1" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">C</text><text x="138.2" y="162" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">D</text><text x="94.7" y="71.3" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">9</text><text x="203.4" y="102.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">15</text></svg>
figure.alt: ABC uchburchak, A burchak bissektrisasi AD (D nuqta BC da); AB = 9, AC = 15.

questions.solution_md:
Bissektrisa xossasi: $\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{AB}{AC}=\dfrac{9}{15}$.

$ABD$ va $ADC$ uchburchaklarning $A$ uchidan tushirilgan balandligi umumiy, demak yuzlar asoslariga proporsional: $\dfrac{S(ABD)}{S(ADC)}=\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{9}{15}$.

Shuning uchun $S(ABD)=48\cdot\dfrac{9}{9+15}=18$ sm².
questions.mistake_note_md: Bissektrisa uchburchakni teng yuzli ikki qismga bo'ladi deb o'ylash (bu mediana xossasi) yoki nisbatni teskari olish.

ru.stem_md: В треугольнике $ABC$ известно: $AB=9$ см, $AC=15$ см, площадь треугольника равна $48$ см². Отрезок $AD$ — биссектриса угла $A$ (точка $D$ лежит на стороне $BC$). Найдите площадь треугольника $ABD$ (в см²).

figure.alt: Треугольник ABC, биссектриса AD угла A (точка D на BC); AB = 9, AC = 15.

ru.solution_md:
Свойство биссектрисы: $\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{AB}{AC}=\dfrac{9}{15}$.

У треугольников $ABD$ и $ADC$ общая высота из вершины $A$, значит их площади относятся как основания: $\dfrac{S(ABD)}{S(ADC)}=\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{9}{15}$.

Поэтому $S(ABD)=48\cdot\dfrac{9}{9+15}=18$ см².
ru.mistake_note_md: Считают, что биссектриса делит треугольник на равные по площади части (это свойство медианы), или берут отношение наоборот.

kaa.solution_md:
Bissektrisa qásiyeti: $\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{AB}{AC}=\dfrac{9}{15}$.

$ABD$ hám $ADC$ úshmúyeshliklerdiń $A$ túyininen túsirilgen biyikligi ulıwma, demek maydanlar tiykarlarına proporcional: $\dfrac{S(ABD)}{S(ADC)}=\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{9}{15}$.

Sonlıqtan $S(ABD)=48\cdot\dfrac{9}{9+15}=18$ sm².

en.stem_md: In triangle $ABC$, $AB=9$ cm, $AC=15$ cm and the area is $48$ cm². Segment $AD$ is the bisector of $\angle A$ ($D$ lies on side $BC$). Find the area of triangle $ABD$ (in cm²).

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polygon points="138.2,32 72.6,125.6 247.4,188" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="138.2" y1="32" x2="138.2" y2="149" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><path d="M 125.5 50 A 22 22 0 0 0 138.2 54" fill="none" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="1.6"/><path d="M 138.2 54 A 22 22 0 0 0 150.8 50" fill="none" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="1.6"/><text x="138.2" y="17" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="57.7" y="127.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="259.3" y="197.1" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">C</text><text x="138.2" y="162" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">D</text><text x="94.7" y="71.3" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">9</text><text x="203.4" y="102.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">15</text></svg>
figure.alt: Triangle ABC with the bisector AD of angle A (D on BC); AB = 9, AC = 15.

en.solution_md:
Angle bisector theorem: $\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{AB}{AC}=\dfrac{9}{15}$.

Triangles $ABD$ and $ADC$ share the altitude from $A$, so their areas are proportional to their bases: $\dfrac{S(ABD)}{S(ADC)}=\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{9}{15}$.

Hence $S(ABD)=48\cdot\dfrac{9}{9+15}=18$ cm².
en.mistake_note_md: Believing the bisector splits the triangle into equal areas (that is a property of the median), or inverting the ratio.

figure.alt: ABC uchburchak, A burchak bissektrisasi AD (D nuqta BC da); AB = 12, AC = 20.

questions.solution_md:
Bissektrisa xossasi: $\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{AB}{AC}=\dfrac{12}{20}$.

$ABD$ va $ADC$ uchburchaklarning $A$ uchidan tushirilgan balandligi umumiy, demak yuzlar asoslariga proporsional: $\dfrac{S(ABD)}{S(ADC)}=\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{12}{20}$.

Shuning uchun $S(ABD)=96\cdot\dfrac{12}{12+20}=36$ sm².
questions.mistake_note_md: Bissektrisa uchburchakni teng yuzli ikki qismga bo'ladi deb o'ylash (bu mediana xossasi) yoki nisbatni teskari olish.

ru.stem_md: В треугольнике $ABC$ известно: $AB=12$ см, $AC=20$ см, площадь треугольника равна $96$ см². Отрезок $AD$ — биссектриса угла $A$ (точка $D$ лежит на стороне $BC$). Найдите площадь треугольника $ABD$ (в см²).

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polygon points="138.2,32 72.6,125.6 247.4,188" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="138.2" y1="32" x2="138.2" y2="149" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><path d="M 125.5 50 A 22 22 0 0 0 138.2 54" fill="none" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="1.6"/><path d="M 138.2 54 A 22 22 0 0 0 150.8 50" fill="none" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="1.6"/><text x="138.2" y="17" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="57.7" y="127.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="259.3" y="197.1" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">C</text><text x="138.2" y="162" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">D</text><text x="94.7" y="71.3" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">12</text><text x="203.4" y="102.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">20</text></svg>
figure.alt: Треугольник ABC, биссектриса AD угла A (точка D на BC); AB = 12, AC = 20.

ru.solution_md:
Свойство биссектрисы: $\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{AB}{AC}=\dfrac{12}{20}$.

У треугольников $ABD$ и $ADC$ общая высота из вершины $A$, значит их площади относятся как основания: $\dfrac{S(ABD)}{S(ADC)}=\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{12}{20}$.

Поэтому $S(ABD)=96\cdot\dfrac{12}{12+20}=36$ см².
ru.mistake_note_md: Считают, что биссектриса делит треугольник на равные по площади части (это свойство медианы), или берут отношение наоборот.

kaa.solution_md:
Bissektrisa qásiyeti: $\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{AB}{AC}=\dfrac{12}{20}$.

$ABD$ hám $ADC$ úshmúyeshliklerdiń $A$ túyininen túsirilgen biyikligi ulıwma, demek maydanlar tiykarlarına proporcional: $\dfrac{S(ABD)}{S(ADC)}=\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{12}{20}$.

Sonlıqtan $S(ABD)=96\cdot\dfrac{12}{12+20}=36$ sm².

en.stem_md: In triangle $ABC$, $AB=12$ cm, $AC=20$ cm and the area is $96$ cm². Segment $AD$ is the bisector of $\angle A$ ($D$ lies on side $BC$). Find the area of triangle $ABD$ (in cm²).

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polygon points="138.2,32 72.6,125.6 247.4,188" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="138.2" y1="32" x2="138.2" y2="149" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><path d="M 125.5 50 A 22 22 0 0 0 138.2 54" fill="none" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="1.6"/><path d="M 138.2 54 A 22 22 0 0 0 150.8 50" fill="none" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="1.6"/><text x="138.2" y="17" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="57.7" y="127.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="259.3" y="197.1" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">C</text><text x="138.2" y="162" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">D</text><text x="94.7" y="71.3" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">12</text><text x="203.4" y="102.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">20</text></svg>
figure.alt: Triangle ABC with the bisector AD of angle A (D on BC); AB = 12, AC = 20.

en.solution_md:
Angle bisector theorem: $\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{AB}{AC}=\dfrac{12}{20}$.

Triangles $ABD$ and $ADC$ share the altitude from $A$, so their areas are proportional to their bases: $\dfrac{S(ABD)}{S(ADC)}=\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{12}{20}$.

Hence $S(ABD)=96\cdot\dfrac{12}{12+20}=36$ cm².
en.mistake_note_md: Believing the bisector splits the triangle into equal areas (that is a property of the median), or inverting the ratio.

figure.alt: ABC uchburchak, A burchak bissektrisasi AD (D nuqta BC da); AB = 8, AC = 12.

questions.solution_md:
Bissektrisa xossasi: $\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{AB}{AC}=\dfrac{8}{12}$.

$ABD$ va $ADC$ uchburchaklarning $A$ uchidan tushirilgan balandligi umumiy, demak yuzlar asoslariga proporsional: $\dfrac{S(ABD)}{S(ADC)}=\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{8}{12}$.

Shuning uchun $S(ABD)=40\cdot\dfrac{8}{8+12}=16$ sm².
questions.mistake_note_md: Bissektrisa uchburchakni teng yuzli ikki qismga bo'ladi deb o'ylash (bu mediana xossasi) yoki nisbatni teskari olish.

ru.stem_md: В треугольнике $ABC$ известно: $AB=8$ см, $AC=12$ см, площадь треугольника равна $40$ см². Отрезок $AD$ — биссектриса угла $A$ (точка $D$ лежит на стороне $BC$). Найдите площадь треугольника $ABD$ (в см²).

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polygon points="141.8,32 69,136 251,188" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="141.8" y1="32" x2="141.8" y2="156.8" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><path d="M 129.2 50 A 22 22 0 0 0 141.8 54" fill="none" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="1.6"/><path d="M 141.8 54 A 22 22 0 0 0 154.4 50" fill="none" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="1.6"/><text x="141.8" y="17" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="54.3" y="139" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="263.2" y="196.7" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">C</text><text x="141.8" y="169.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">D</text><text x="94.7" y="76.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">8</text><text x="207.1" y="102.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">12</text></svg>
figure.alt: Треугольник ABC, биссектриса AD угла A (точка D на BC); AB = 8, AC = 12.

ru.solution_md:
Свойство биссектрисы: $\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{AB}{AC}=\dfrac{8}{12}$.

У треугольников $ABD$ и $ADC$ общая высота из вершины $A$, значит их площади относятся как основания: $\dfrac{S(ABD)}{S(ADC)}=\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{8}{12}$.

Поэтому $S(ABD)=40\cdot\dfrac{8}{8+12}=16$ см².
ru.mistake_note_md: Считают, что биссектриса делит треугольник на равные по площади части (это свойство медианы), или берут отношение наоборот.

kaa.solution_md:
Bissektrisa qásiyeti: $\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{AB}{AC}=\dfrac{8}{12}$.

$ABD$ hám $ADC$ úshmúyeshliklerdiń $A$ túyininen túsirilgen biyikligi ulıwma, demek maydanlar tiykarlarına proporcional: $\dfrac{S(ABD)}{S(ADC)}=\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{8}{12}$.

en.stem_md: In triangle $ABC$, $AB=8$ cm, $AC=12$ cm and the area is $40$ cm². Segment $AD$ is the bisector of $\angle A$ ($D$ lies on side $BC$). Find the area of triangle $ABD$ (in cm²).

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polygon points="141.8,32 69,136 251,188" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="141.8" y1="32" x2="141.8" y2="156.8" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><path d="M 129.2 50 A 22 22 0 0 0 141.8 54" fill="none" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="1.6"/><path d="M 141.8 54 A 22 22 0 0 0 154.4 50" fill="none" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="1.6"/><text x="141.8" y="17" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="54.3" y="139" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="263.2" y="196.7" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">C</text><text x="141.8" y="169.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">D</text><text x="94.7" y="76.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">8</text><text x="207.1" y="102.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">12</text></svg>
figure.alt: Triangle ABC with the bisector AD of angle A (D on BC); AB = 8, AC = 12.

en.solution_md:
Angle bisector theorem: $\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{AB}{AC}=\dfrac{8}{12}$.

Triangles $ABD$ and $ADC$ share the altitude from $A$, so their areas are proportional to their bases: $\dfrac{S(ABD)}{S(ADC)}=\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{8}{12}$.

Hence $S(ABD)=40\cdot\dfrac{8}{8+12}=16$ cm².
en.mistake_note_md: Believing the bisector splits the triangle into equal areas (that is a property of the median), or inverting the ratio.

en.solution_md:
Angle bisector theorem: $\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{AB}{AC}=\dfrac{6}{9}$.

Triangles $ABD$ and $ADC$ share the altitude from $A$, so their areas are proportional to their bases: $\dfrac{S(ABD)}{S(ADC)}=\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{6}{9}$.

Hence $S(ABD)=15\cdot\dfrac{6}{6+9}=6$ cm².
en.mistake_note_md: Believing the bisector splits the triangle into equal areas (that is a property of the median), or inverting the ratio.

$ABD$ va $ADC$ uchburchaklarning $A$ uchidan tushirilgan balandligi umumiy, demak yuzlar asoslariga proporsional: $\dfrac{S(ABD)}{S(ADC)}=\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{10}{14}$.

Shuning uchun $S(ABD)=48\cdot\dfrac{10}{10+14}=20$ sm².
questions.mistake_note_md: Bissektrisa uchburchakni teng yuzli ikki qismga bo'ladi deb o'ylash (bu mediana xossasi) yoki nisbatni teskari olish.

ru.solution_md:
Свойство биссектрисы: $\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{AB}{AC}=\dfrac{10}{14}$.

У треугольников $ABD$ и $ADC$ общая высота из вершины $A$, значит их площади относятся как основания: $\dfrac{S(ABD)}{S(ADC)}=\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{10}{14}$.

Поэтому $S(ABD)=48\cdot\dfrac{10}{10+14}=20$ см².
ru.mistake_note_md: Считают, что биссектриса делит треугольник на равные по площади части (это свойство медианы), или берут отношение наоборот.

en.solution_md:
Angle bisector theorem: $\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{AB}{AC}=\dfrac{10}{14}$.

Triangles $ABD$ and $ADC$ share the altitude from $A$, so their areas are proportional to their bases: $\dfrac{S(ABD)}{S(ADC)}=\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{10}{14}$.

Hence $S(ABD)=48\cdot\dfrac{10}{10+14}=20$ cm².
en.mistake_note_md: Believing the bisector splits the triangle into equal areas (that is a property of the median), or inverting the ratio.

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polygon points="127.2,32 83.5,94.4 236.5,188" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="127.2" y1="32" x2="127.2" y2="121.1" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><path d="M 114.6 50 A 22 22 0 0 0 127.2 54" fill="none" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="1.6"/><path d="M 127.2 54 A 22 22 0 0 0 139.8 50" fill="none" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="1.6"/><text x="127.2" y="17" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="68.7" y="92" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="247.3" y="198.3" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">C</text><text x="127.2" y="134.1" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">D</text><text x="94.7" y="55.7" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="192.5" y="102.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">10</text></svg>
figure.alt: Треугольник ABC, биссектриса AD угла A (точка D на BC); AB = 4, AC = 10.

ru.solution_md:
Свойство биссектрисы: $\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{AB}{AC}=\dfrac{4}{10}$.

У треугольников $ABD$ и $ADC$ общая высота из вершины $A$, значит их площади относятся как основания: $\dfrac{S(ABD)}{S(ADC)}=\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{4}{10}$.

Поэтому $S(ABD)=14\cdot\dfrac{4}{4+10}=4$ см².
ru.mistake_note_md: Считают, что биссектриса делит треугольник на равные по площади части (это свойство медианы), или берут отношение наоборот.

$ABD$ hám $ADC$ úshmúyeshliklerdiń $A$ túyininen túsirilgen biyikligi ulıwma, demek maydanlar tiykarlarına proporcional: $\dfrac{S(ABD)}{S(ADC)}=\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{4}{10}$.

en.stem_md: In triangle $ABC$, $AB=4$ cm, $AC=10$ cm and the area is $14$ cm². Segment $AD$ is the bisector of $\angle A$ ($D$ lies on side $BC$). Find the area of triangle $ABD$ (in cm²).

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polygon points="127.2,32 83.5,94.4 236.5,188" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="127.2" y1="32" x2="127.2" y2="121.1" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><path d="M 114.6 50 A 22 22 0 0 0 127.2 54" fill="none" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="1.6"/><path d="M 127.2 54 A 22 22 0 0 0 139.8 50" fill="none" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="1.6"/><text x="127.2" y="17" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="68.7" y="92" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="247.3" y="198.3" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">C</text><text x="127.2" y="134.1" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">D</text><text x="94.7" y="55.7" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">4</text><text x="192.5" y="102.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">10</text></svg>
figure.alt: Triangle ABC with the bisector AD of angle A (D on BC); AB = 4, AC = 10.

en.solution_md:
Angle bisector theorem: $\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{AB}{AC}=\dfrac{4}{10}$.

Triangles $ABD$ and $ADC$ share the altitude from $A$, so their areas are proportional to their bases: $\dfrac{S(ABD)}{S(ADC)}=\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{4}{10}$.

Hence $S(ABD)=14\cdot\dfrac{4}{4+10}=4$ cm².
en.mistake_note_md: Believing the bisector splits the triangle into equal areas (that is a property of the median), or inverting the ratio.

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polygon points="141.8,32 69,136 251,188" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="141.8" y1="32" x2="141.8" y2="156.8" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><path d="M 129.2 50 A 22 22 0 0 0 141.8 54" fill="none" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="1.6"/><path d="M 141.8 54 A 22 22 0 0 0 154.4 50" fill="none" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="1.6"/><text x="141.8" y="17" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="54.3" y="139" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="263.2" y="196.7" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">C</text><text x="141.8" y="169.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">D</text><text x="94.7" y="76.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">10</text><text x="207.1" y="102.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">15</text></svg>
figure.alt: Треугольник ABC, биссектриса AD угла A (точка D на BC); AB = 10, AC = 15.

ru.solution_md:
Свойство биссектрисы: $\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{AB}{AC}=\dfrac{10}{15}$.

У треугольников $ABD$ и $ADC$ общая высота из вершины $A$, значит их площади относятся как основания: $\dfrac{S(ABD)}{S(ADC)}=\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{10}{15}$.

Поэтому $S(ABD)=50\cdot\dfrac{10}{10+15}=20$ см².
ru.mistake_note_md: Считают, что биссектриса делит треугольник на равные по площади части (это свойство медианы), или берут отношение наоборот.

kaa.solution_md:

$ABD$ hám $ADC$ úshmúyeshliklerdiń $A$ túyininen túsirilgen biyikligi ulıwma, demek maydanlar tiykarlarına proporcional: $\dfrac{S(ABD)}{S(ADC)}=\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{10}{15}$.

en.stem_md: In triangle $ABC$, $AB=10$ cm, $AC=15$ cm and the area is $50$ cm². Segment $AD$ is the bisector of $\angle A$ ($D$ lies on side $BC$). Find the area of triangle $ABD$ (in cm²).

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polygon points="141.8,32 69,136 251,188" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="141.8" y1="32" x2="141.8" y2="156.8" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><path d="M 129.2 50 A 22 22 0 0 0 141.8 54" fill="none" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="1.6"/><path d="M 141.8 54 A 22 22 0 0 0 154.4 50" fill="none" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="1.6"/><text x="141.8" y="17" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="54.3" y="139" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="263.2" y="196.7" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">C</text><text x="141.8" y="169.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">D</text><text x="94.7" y="76.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">10</text><text x="207.1" y="102.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">15</text></svg>
figure.alt: Triangle ABC with the bisector AD of angle A (D on BC); AB = 10, AC = 15.

en.solution_md:
Angle bisector theorem: $\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{AB}{AC}=\dfrac{10}{15}$.

Triangles $ABD$ and $ADC$ share the altitude from $A$, so their areas are proportional to their bases: $\dfrac{S(ABD)}{S(ADC)}=\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{10}{15}$.

Hence $S(ABD)=50\cdot\dfrac{10}{10+15}=20$ cm².
en.mistake_note_md: Believing the bisector splits the triangle into equal areas (that is a property of the median), or inverting the ratio.

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polygon points="141.8,32 69,136 251,188" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="141.8" y1="32" x2="141.8" y2="156.8" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><path d="M 129.2 50 A 22 22 0 0 0 141.8 54" fill="none" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="1.6"/><path d="M 141.8 54 A 22 22 0 0 0 154.4 50" fill="none" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="1.6"/><text x="141.8" y="17" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="54.3" y="139" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="263.2" y="196.7" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">C</text><text x="141.8" y="169.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">D</text><text x="94.7" y="76.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">12</text><text x="207.1" y="102.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">18</text></svg>
figure.alt: Треугольник ABC, биссектриса AD угла A (точка D на BC); AB = 12, AC = 18.

ru.solution_md:
Свойство биссектрисы: $\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{AB}{AC}=\dfrac{12}{18}$.

У треугольников $ABD$ и $ADC$ общая высота из вершины $A$, значит их площади относятся как основания: $\dfrac{S(ABD)}{S(ADC)}=\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{12}{18}$.

Поэтому $S(ABD)=90\cdot\dfrac{12}{12+18}=36$ см².
ru.mistake_note_md: Считают, что биссектриса делит треугольник на равные по площади части (это свойство медианы), или берут отношение наоборот.

$ABD$ hám $ADC$ úshmúyeshliklerdiń $A$ túyininen túsirilgen biyikligi ulıwma, demek maydanlar tiykarlarına proporcional: $\dfrac{S(ABD)}{S(ADC)}=\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{12}{18}$.

en.stem_md: In triangle $ABC$, $AB=12$ cm, $AC=18$ cm and the area is $90$ cm². Segment $AD$ is the bisector of $\angle A$ ($D$ lies on side $BC$). Find the area of triangle $ABD$ (in cm²).

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polygon points="141.8,32 69,136 251,188" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="141.8" y1="32" x2="141.8" y2="156.8" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><path d="M 129.2 50 A 22 22 0 0 0 141.8 54" fill="none" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="1.6"/><path d="M 141.8 54 A 22 22 0 0 0 154.4 50" fill="none" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="1.6"/><text x="141.8" y="17" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="54.3" y="139" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="263.2" y="196.7" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">C</text><text x="141.8" y="169.8" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">D</text><text x="94.7" y="76.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">12</text><text x="207.1" y="102.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">18</text></svg>
figure.alt: Triangle ABC with the bisector AD of angle A (D on BC); AB = 12, AC = 18.

en.solution_md:
Angle bisector theorem: $\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{AB}{AC}=\dfrac{12}{18}$.

Triangles $ABD$ and $ADC$ share the altitude from $A$, so their areas are proportional to their bases: $\dfrac{S(ABD)}{S(ADC)}=\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{12}{18}$.

Hence $S(ABD)=90\cdot\dfrac{12}{12+18}=36$ cm².
en.mistake_note_md: Believing the bisector splits the triangle into equal areas (that is a property of the median), or inverting the ratio.

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polygon points="138.2,32 72.6,125.6 247.4,188" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="138.2" y1="32" x2="138.2" y2="149" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><path d="M 125.5 50 A 22 22 0 0 0 138.2 54" fill="none" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="1.6"/><path d="M 138.2 54 A 22 22 0 0 0 150.8 50" fill="none" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="1.6"/><text x="138.2" y="17" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="57.7" y="127.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="259.3" y="197.1" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">C</text><text x="138.2" y="162" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">D</text><text x="94.7" y="71.3" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">9</text><text x="203.4" y="102.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">15</text></svg>
figure.alt: Треугольник ABC, биссектриса AD угла A (точка D на BC); AB = 9, AC = 15.

ru.solution_md:
Свойство биссектрисы: $\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{AB}{AC}=\dfrac{9}{15}$.

У треугольников $ABD$ и $ADC$ общая высота из вершины $A$, значит их площади относятся как основания: $\dfrac{S(ABD)}{S(ADC)}=\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{9}{15}$.

Поэтому $S(ABD)=48\cdot\dfrac{9}{9+15}=18$ см².
ru.mistake_note_md: Считают, что биссектриса делит треугольник на равные по площади части (это свойство медианы), или берут отношение наоборот.

kaa.solution_md:
Bissektrisa qásiyeti: $\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{AB}{AC}=\dfrac{9}{15}$.

$ABD$ hám $ADC$ úshmúyeshliklerdiń $A$ túyininen túsirilgen biyikligi ulıwma, demek maydanlar tiykarlarına proporcional: $\dfrac{S(ABD)}{S(ADC)}=\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{9}{15}$.

Sonlıqtan $S(ABD)=48\cdot\dfrac{9}{9+15}=18$ sm².

en.solution_md:
Angle bisector theorem: $\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{AB}{AC}=\dfrac{9}{15}$.

Triangles $ABD$ and $ADC$ share the altitude from $A$, so their areas are proportional to their bases: $\dfrac{S(ABD)}{S(ADC)}=\dfrac{BD}{DC}=\dfrac{9}{15}$.

Hence $S(ABD)=48\cdot\dfrac{9}{9+15}=18$ cm².
en.mistake_note_md: Believing the bisector splits the triangle into equal areas (that is a property of the median), or inverting the ratio.

ru.mistake_note_md: Переворачивают отношение ($\frac{BD}{DC}=\frac{AC}{AB}$) либо делят $BC$ пополам.

kaa.stem_md: $ABC$ úshmúyeshlikte $AB=7$, $AC=11$, $BC=15$. $A$ múyeshiniń bissektrisası $BC$ táreptı $D$ noqatında kesedi. $BD$ dı tabıń.
kaa.solution_md: $\frac{BD}{DC}=\frac{AB}{AC}=\frac{7}{11}\Rightarrow BD=\frac{15\cdot 7}{18}=\frac{35}{6}$ Juwap: $\frac{35}{6}$.
kaa.mistake_note_md: Qatnastı keri qoyıw ($\frac{BD}{DC}=\frac{AC}{AB}$) yamasa $BC$ nı teń bóliw.

en.stem_md: In triangle $ABC$, $AB=7$, $AC=11$, $BC=15$. The bisector of angle $A$ meets $BC$ at $D$. Find $BD$.
en.solution_md: $\frac{BD}{DC}=\frac{AB}{AC}=\frac{7}{11}\Rightarrow BD=\frac{15\cdot 7}{18}=\frac{35}{6}$ Answer: $\frac{35}{6}$.
en.mistake_note_md: Inverting the ratio ($\frac{BD}{DC}=\frac{AC}{AB}$) or halving $BC$.

questions.stem_md: $ABC$ uchburchakda $AB=5$, $AC=6$, $BC=6$. $A$ burchak bissektrisasi $BC$ tomonni $D$ nuqtada kesadi. $BD$ ni toping.
questions.solution_md: $\frac{BD}{DC}=\frac{AB}{AC}=\frac{5}{6}\Rightarrow BD=\frac{6\cdot 5}{11}=\frac{30}{11}$ Javob: $\frac{30}{11}$.
questions.mistake_note_md: Nisbatni teskari qo'yish ($\frac{BD}{DC}=\frac{AC}{AB}$) yoki $BC$ ni teng bo'lish.

questions.stem_md: Uchburchak medianasining uzunligi $21$. Medianalar kesishgan nuqtadan shu median chiqqan uchgacha bo'lgan masofani toping.
questions.solution_md: Medianalar kesishish nuqtasida $2:1$ nisbatda bo'linadi (uchdan hisoblanganda); o'rta chiziq tomonning yarmi. Javob: $14$.
questions.mistake_note_md: Markaz medianani teng ($1:1$) bo'ladi deb olish.

ru.stem_md: Длина медианы треугольника равна $21$. Найдите расстояние от точки пересечения медиан до вершины, из которой проведена эта медиана.
ru.solution_md: Медианы точкой пересечения делятся в отношении $2:1$ (от вершины); средняя линия равна половине стороны. Ответ: $14$.
ru.mistake_note_md: Считают, что центр делит медиану пополам.

kaa.stem_md: Úshmúyeshlik medianasınıń uzınlıǵı $21$. Medianalar kesilisken noqattan usı mediana shıqqan ushqa shekem aralıqtı tabıń.
kaa.solution_md: Medianalar kesilisiw noqatında $2:1$ qatnasında bólinedi (ushtan esaplaǵanda); orta sızıq táreptiń yarımı. Juwap: $14$.
kaa.mistake_note_md: Orayın medianı teń ($1:1$) bóledi dep alıw.

en.stem_md: A median of a triangle has length $21$. Find the distance from the centroid to the vertex from which the median is drawn.
en.solution_md: Medians are divided $2:1$ at the centroid (from the vertex); a midline is half the side. Answer: $14$.
en.mistake_note_md: Assuming the centroid halves the median.
